## Code

### P2 Expression Audio Generator · Expression

```
// a: pitch, b: modulator ratio, c: modulation depth.
var fc := 40 + 80 a;
var ratio := 1 + round(7 b);
m1[0] := frac(m1[0] + fc / fs);
m1[1] := frac(m1[1] + fc ratio / fs);
var s := 0.4 sin(2 pi m1[0] + 8 c sin(2 pi m1[1]));
out[0] := s;
out[1] := s;
```
